collection.title: Ford Galaxy 2015 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Galaxy 2015 - 2018 version uses a 30" wiper blade on both drviers and passenger side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Galaxy which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
